result.instructions: Tools for Fathom Analytics, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fathom Analytics data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run fathom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fathom_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fathom_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. fathom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fathom_get_token
tools.title: Get the API token's permissions
tools.description: The connected API token's name, permissions (abilities: "*" = Admin, "all-sites-readonly", or per-site read:<id> / manage:<id>) and timestamps. The secret value is never returned. Good first call to know which tools will work. GET /token.

tools.name: fathom_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: The Fathom account that owns the API token: id, name and email. Needs an Admin token (the * scope). GET /account.

tools.name: fathom_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the sites the token can read (id, name, sharing, timezone, created_at), oldest first. The site id is what every report tool takes. Needs an Admin or all-sites read-only token; a token scoped to a single site cannot list sites, so use fathom_get_site with that site id instead. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites.

starting_after.description: Page forward: pass next.starting_after from the previous reply (an object id).

ending_before.description: Page backward from this object id (newest first). Not together with starting_after.

tools.name: fathom_get_site
tools.title: Get a site
tools.description: One site: id, name, sharing (none/private/public), timezone and created_at. GET /sites/{site_id}.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

tools.name: fathom_list_events
tools.title: List a site's events
tools.description: List a site's events (conversions/goals): every event name the site has tracked plus events with a currency set, sorted by name. Identify events by name (use it as event_name in fathom_get_aggregation); the id is only a paging cursor. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/events.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

starting_after.description: Page forward: pass next.starting_after from the previous reply (an object id).

ending_before.description: Page backward from this object id (newest first). Not together with starting_after.

tools.name: fathom_list_milestones
tools.title: List a site's milestones
tools.description: List a site's milestones (dated annotations on reports, such as a redesign launch or a campaign start), oldest first. Paged: pass next.starting_after. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

starting_after.description: Page forward: pass next.starting_after from the previous reply (an object id).

ending_before.description: Page backward from this object id (newest first). Not together with starting_after.

tools.name: fathom_get_milestone
tools.title: Get a milestone
tools.description: One milestone: id, name, milestone_date, created_at, updated_at. GET /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

milestone_id.description: The milestone id (a UUID, from fathom_list_milestones).

tools.name: fathom_get_aggregation
tools.title: Run a traffic or event report
tools.description: Fathom's custom report (the dashboard's numbers): aggregate pageviews or one event over a date range, optionally grouped by date and/or fields and filtered. Pageviews: aggregates visits (unique site visits), uniques (unique page visits), pageviews, avg_duration (seconds), bounce_rate. Events (entity event + event_name): conversions, unique_conversions, value (in cents). Examples: top pages = field_grouping [pathname], sort_by pageviews:desc; traffic sources = [referrer_source] or [referrer_hostname]; AI referrals = [ai_source]; daily trend = date_grouping day. All numbers come back as strings. Dates are in the site's timezone; hour grouping only for ranges up to 7 days. Grouped reports return at most 500 rows unless limit is set (max 1000, no paging), so narrow with filters or dates. Data before March 2021 cannot be grouped/filtered. GET /aggregations.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

entity.description: pageview = site traffic; event = one event's conversions (needs event_name).

event_name.description: For entity event: the event's name, as listed by fathom_list_events.

aggregates.description: Metrics. pageview: visits, uniques, pageviews, avg_duration, bounce_rate. event: conversions, unique_conversions, value.

date_grouping.description: Group by time (omit for one total). hour only for ranges up to 7 days.

field_grouping.description: Group by these fields, e.g. [pathname] or [referrer_source, utm_campaign].

sort_by.description: "<field>:asc|desc" with a field from aggregates or field_grouping (or timestamp with date_grouping), e.g. pageviews:desc.

date_from.description: Start, YYYY-MM-DD (start of day) or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", in the site's timezone. Default: the first recorded data.

date_to.description: End, YYYY-MM-DD (end of day) or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", in the site's timezone. Default: now.

limit.description: Row cap, 1-1000 (default 500 when grouping by fields).

property.description: Field to filter on (domain is filter-only; keyword cannot be filtered).

operator.description: is, is not, is like (contains, * wildcards), is not like, matching (regex), not matching. Categorical fields (device_type, operating_system, browser, country_code, city, state, region) allow only is / is not.

value.description: The value to compare with, always a string (e.g. /pricing, GB, Mobile, ChatGPT).

annotations.title: Run a traffic or event report

tools.name: fathom_get_current_visitors
tools.title: Get current visitors
tools.description: Live visitors on a site right now: the total, and with detailed true the top 150 pages (hostname, pathname, total) and top 150 referrers. GET /current_visitors.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

detailed.description: true = also the top pages and referrers (default false: only the count).

tools.name: fathom_create_site
tools.title: Create a site
tools.description: Create a new site in the Fathom account (returns its id, used in the tracking code). Needs an Admin token. Sharing private needs share_password; multi_domain true needs multi_domain_option. POST /sites.

name.description: Site name (up to 255 characters; need not match the URL).

sharing.description: Dashboard sharing: none (default), private (password) or public.

share_password.description: Required when sharing is private: the password for the shared dashboard.

timezone.description: Reporting timezone as a TZ database name, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, UTC.

multi_domain.description: true = the site may track multiple domains.

multi_domain_option.description: Required when multi_domain is true: report domains combined or separate.

tools.name: fathom_update_site
tools.title: Update a site
tools.description: Change a site's name, sharing, timezone or multi-domain setting (send only what changes). Changing the timezone changes how reports are bucketed. Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

sharing.description: Dashboard sharing: none, private (needs share_password) or public.

share_password.description: Required when setting sharing to private.

timezone.description: Reporting timezone as a TZ database name, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, UTC.

multi_domain.description: true = the site may track multiple domains.

multi_domain_option.description: Required when multi_domain is true: combined or separate.

tools.name: fathom_set_event_currency
tools.title: Set an event's currency
tools.description: Set the currency of an event's value by event name (works before the event is first tracked). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/events/currency.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

event_name.description: The event's name exactly as tracked (up to 255 characters; fathom_list_events lists them).

currency.description: dollar, pound, euro, yuan, peso, shekel, yen, won, hryvnia, franc, rupee, integer (a plain number) or none.

tools.name: fathom_clear_event_currency
tools.title: Clear an event's currency
tools.description: Remove the currency set for an event, so it uses the site's default again. The event and its completion data stay. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/events?name=.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

event_name.description: The event's name exactly as tracked (fathom_list_events lists them).

tools.name: fathom_create_milestone
tools.title: Create a milestone
tools.description: Add a milestone (a dated annotation shown on the site's reports, e.g. a launch or campaign start). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

name.description: Milestone name (up to 30 characters), e.g. Redesign launch.

tools.name: fathom_update_milestone
tools.title: Update a milestone
tools.description: Rename or re-date a milestone (both name and milestone_date are required). Needs a manage token for the site. POST /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

milestone_id.description: The milestone id (a UUID, from fathom_list_milestones).

name.description: Milestone name (up to 30 characters), e.g. Redesign launch.

tools.name: fathom_delete_milestone
tools.title: Delete a milestone
tools.description: Permanently delete a milestone (only the annotation; traffic data is not touched). Cannot be undone. Needs a manage token for the site. DELETE /sites/{site_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}.

site_id.description: The site id, the same string as in the tracking code (e.g. CDBUGS). fathom_list_sites lists them.

milestone_id.description: The milestone id (a UUID, from fathom_list_milestones).
